metric_definition_warnings: Johannesburg Water Business Plan 2025/26 page 95 describes the 48-hour water-burst KPI as on-site response and initiation of resolution, explicitly not necessarily completed resolution, although the KPI title says restored within 48 hours.

Johannesburg Water FY2024/25 annual report reports 70.35% against an 85% target; this must not be compared to the 2025/26 business-plan baseline 67.46% and 90% target without reconciled periods and definitions.
The 99.20% Business Plan figure refers to E. coli sample compliance, not full SANS 241 water-quality compliance.

The Johannesburg Water Business Plan 2025/26 uses a 48-hour burst KPI title saying restored, while its operational definition says arrived on site and initiated resolution, explicitly not necessarily resolved. FY2024/25 annual-report achievement and the FY2025/26 business-plan 2023/24 baseline must remain separate pending reconciliation.
